audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers had Vayne winning Level 1 and Level 6 and Poppy winning 4-5 and 2+ items, contradicting packet.levelChart and the whys.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is Skill/Poppy/Poppy/Skill/Skill/Poppy/Vayne. whys[0] says both are weak level 1, whys[3] and whys[4] say 'even', whys[6] says she out-scales hard. The chart was the only thing disagreeing.
audit.corrected: Rows 0,1,3,4,6 flipped in matched full+content pairs with ratings updated.

audit.why: Spikes correctly place Poppy's window at levels 2-3 and first item and Vayne's at Botrk/Shieldbow; Final Hour (100/85/70s) grants Tumble invisibility, already reflected in whys[6] and late.

audit.whatIsWrong: Condemn cancelling Keeper's Verdict was absent, the Tumble auto-attack-reset tell was absent, and the trading lines used male pronouns for Vayne with a generic 'his answer' placeholder.
audit.why: Poppy's R is a channel and any CC cancels it; Condemn is hard CC with knockback at 550 range on 20/18/16/14/12s. Tumble carries an auto-reset flag, so the attack wind-up — not the cast — is the tell to hold W. Steadfast Presence stops Tumble as a dash and grounds her.
audit.corrected: Both interactions now stated with cooldowns; pronouns and the placeholder 'his answer' replaced with Condemn's real timer.

audit.whatIsWrong: Don't entries had bodies that did not match their headings (the 'Stack pure HP vs her W' entry said nothing about HP or true damage).
audit.why: Silver Bolts' third consecutive hit is percent-max-health true damage, so HP stacking is exactly the mistake named in the heading.
audit.corrected: Each don't body now answers its own heading.

edits.before: Your W disables her tumble — E-stun her, all-in. Poppy wins the Tumble cooldown windows.
edits.after: W stops Tumble mid-dash — E-stun her, all-in. Condemn cancels your R channel, so bait it first.

edits.before: E Vayne into a wall when his answer is down, Q the zone under him, and W any dash he tries — his mobility is a suggestion.
edits.after: E her into a wall once Condemn (20s at rank 1) is spent, Q the zone under her, and W her Tumble — her kite dies grounded.

edits.before: E-ing with no wall behind him — the wall-stun is the whole trade; the dash alone is a tickle.
edits.after: E-ing with no wall behind her — the stun is the trade, and a bare dash walks you into Silver Bolts.

edits.before: Keeper’s Verdict punts the fight’s biggest threat across the map. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Vayne's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Keeper's Verdict punts her off you, but Condemn cancels the channel and Final Hour hides her Tumble — even level, so bait E before you ult.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Vayne carry threat 9.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: She takes over: Silver Bolts' third hit is percent-HP true damage, so your armour and HP do nothing. Frontline and peel — never side-lane duel.

edits.before: Dash — your W disables her kite! Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Tumble is 6s at rank 1 and 2s at rank 5. W it, or step in right after.

edits.before: E Vayne into a wall when his answer is down, Q the zone under him, and W any dash he tries — his mobility is a suggestion.
edits.after: Her combo opens with a Tumble auto-reset — the wind-up is your cue to hold W, not the cast; stopping the dash grounds and slows her.

edits.before: Vayne wastes Tumble (Dash) — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Vayne burns Tumble — E-Q her into terrain before it is back in 6s.

edits.before: That is Vayne's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Silver Bolts' third hit is true damage — raw HP feeds it. Buy armour.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Without W up she tumbles free — walk at her only when it is ready.

edits.before: E-ing with no wall behind him — the wall-stun is the whole trade; the dash alone is a tickle.
edits.after: Botrk and Shieldbow online: her true damage ignores every resistance you bought.

edits.before: Track Vayne's Tumble (Dash): Dash — your W disables her kite! When it is down — E-Q + R her.
edits.after: Tumble is a dash — W stops it dead. Condemn cancels Keeper's Verdict mid-channel, so bait it first.

notes: Full and content charts agreed with each other but both disagreed with packet.levelChart and with the content whys; flipped as one atomic paired group. Several full-layer strings referred to Vayne as 'him/his' and carried a generic 'his answer is down' placeholder — replaced with Condemn's real cooldown.
